home.tagline: A dexterity simulator for the <abbr>CKA</abbr> certification.
home.intro: No cluster to spin up, no €50 mock exam. Just: a scenario, a command, a chrono.
home.whyP1: The CKA gives you 2h for ~15-20 tasks on a real cluster. Your kubectl typing speed (alias <c>k</c>, <c>--dry-run=client -o yaml</c>, <c>-n</c>, JSONPath…) decides whether you finish in time or run out.
home.whyP2: This tool drills that exact reflex. It will later extend to shell and vi (the other silent CKA bottlenecks).

about.title: About & Roadmap
about.intro: CKA-Sim is a local-first dexterity simulator for the CKA certification. Command validation is deterministic (regex); an AI tutor (Claude OAuth or OpenRouter) will land as an enrichment layer, grounded on the official documentation via RAG.
about.sprint1: Sprint 1 — Pure kubectl dexterity: scenario → command → chrono. Regex validation. Done.
about.sprint2: Sprint 2 (current) — Persistence: SQLite runs/attempts + personal dashboard.
about.sprint3: Sprint 3 — AI tutor (Claude OAuth + OpenRouter), post-answer feedback, no RAG yet (can hallucinate).
about.sprint4: Sprint 4 — Doc-grounded RAG (sqlite-vec + local/OpenRouter embeddings), citations in answers.
about.sprint5: Sprint 5 — Shell and vi extensions (codemirror-vim) with keystroke-efficiency scoring.
about.sprint6: Sprint 6 — Custom web sources + admin ingestion UI.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure the AI tutor and the embedding provider for the documentation-grounded RAG. All keys stay on your device.
settings.tutorEnabledHint: Adds an explanation panel after each answer. Disabled in exam mode.
settings.examModeHint: Replicates real CKA conditions: pure dexterity, no assistance.
settings.providerHint: Choose which model powers the tutor. Both options are bring-your-own-key.
settings.providerClaudeHint: Uses your existing Claude.ai subscription via OAuth — no API key needed.
settings.providerOpenrouterHint: Pay-per-token via your OpenRouter API key. Pick any supported chat model.
settings.embeddingsHint: Used to retrieve relevant Kubernetes docs before each tutor reply. Must match the bundled vector index.
settings.ragEnabled: Use retrieval (RAG) when calling the tutor
settings.ragEnabledHint: When off, the tutor answers from its own knowledge — faster but more prone to hallucinations.
settings.futureNotice: Sprint 3 ships the actual AI calls; today this page only persists your preferences.
